AS9100D is required for Aviation, Space, and Defense Organizations which are the major customers for electron beam weld shops. Each facility also has National Aerospace and Defense Contractors Accreditation Program (Nadcap) accreditation Nadcap AC7004 Aerospace Quality Systems, and Nadcap AC7110 Welding. Roark is a certified Department of Transportation (DOT) Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Repair Station YWER845L certified for electron beam welding repair. In addition to the high capital investment in the equipment a facility requires sufficient infrastructure including power, water, compressed air, sufficient foundation, HVAC, and heavy lifting equipment.
